purpose: Fork-only VDLU material for the Forgejo build: the owner's update-signing public key, and files vendored verbatim from VDLiveUpdate. build() (module-ci.conf) ships the key as the only keyring entry and the curl binaries as module/bin/<abi>/curl.
why_vendored: The build, the release step and the offline tests must use the same bytes; the tests and the gate run without network, and every build needs the curl binaries.
